create_roidataloader: create a RoIDataLoader instance with a roidb and configure the number of loader threads
start_loader_threads: start the RoIDataLoader worker and enqueuer threads with optional prefill of the minibatch queue
shutdown_loader: shutdown the RoIDataLoader by stopping all threads and closing blob queues gracefully
enqueue_blobs_to_gpu: enqueue a minibatch of blobs onto a GPU BlobsQueue using SafeEnqueueBlobs operator
shuffle_roidb_inds: shuffle the roidb indices with optional aspect grouping to group similar aspect ratio images
